title: CONFIDE: Contextual Finite Difference Modelling of PDEs

problem.claim: Infer an explicit PDE from a data sample generated by previously unseen dynamics using learned context.

contributions.claim: A contextual finite-difference method for inferring explicit PDEs from data generated by previously unseen dynamics.
A training and inference approach that combines equation-form knowledge with a differential scheme and produces a PDE for signal prediction and data explanation.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report extensive experiments comparing their method with state-of-the-art approaches.
The authors report ablation studies examining different variants of their solution.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper addresses inferring explicit PDEs from samples produced by previously unseen dynamics.
The approach uses learned context, equation-form knowledge, and a differential scheme to infer a PDE that supports prediction and explanation.
The paper reports comparisons with state-of-the-art methods and ablations of solution variants.
